description_for_model: DPX is a programmable stablecoin settlement rail for AI agents. Validated integrations: Coinbase AgentKit (CDP MPC wallet), Circle Developer Wallets, LangChain, MCP. Discovery-first protocol: call GET /manifest to discover capabilities cold, GET /reliability for oracle status, GET /quote to price a settlement, POST /settle to execute. Native x402 micropayment support on Base. Call GET /quote for the live, binding price of any settlement before executing — don't assume a fixed rate.
description_for_human: Real-time DPX stablecoin stability oracle with agent-native pricing and programmable settlement rails on Base mainnet.
